scope: Scratch consumed response-shape guards for retained Units/Leave parent refresh only; no applied source edits or browser execution.
integration: Insert helper fragment before profileParentReadSequence in the rebased profile parent proposal.
Inside the existing owned Units GET path, call assertProfileUnitReadShape(result) after read ownership checks and before result.month or any unitManagement/units/unitAssignments assignment.

Inside the existing owned Leave Promise.all path, call assertProfileLeaveReadShape(calendar, requests, pressure, month) before calendar.month/calendar.summary.month/pressure.month checks or any leaveCalendar/leaveRequests/leavePressure assignment.
Preserve the existing month identity checks, current/owned gates, cache invalidation, error notice and GET-only retry. Existing Array.isArray(requests) check becomes redundant but may remain.
This scratch main is based on V3/B0 and must be rebased onto the final applied stage source. Do not copy it over current main.ts directly.

Units root: validation_issues[]; missing or non-array collections would throw or silently corrupt shared state
Unit object: id/name strings for matches, escaped names and modal navigation; campus nullable text for filters; minimum_free_people finite number for settings value and retained input context
Posting: id/posting_type/starts_on strings; nested person.id/canonical_name strings and nullable person.call_level; nullable unit uses consumed Unit shape; ends_on/notes/effective_call_level nullable text; source/active_status/unconsumed fields are not required
Unit summaries: unit_id string; assigned_members/people_with_leave/leave_days checked only when non-null, because existing unavailable presentation intentionally tolerates absent counts; no eligibility/range/integer/sum policy is added
Call rules: unit_id/call_level strings; assigned_members/minimum_free_people/max_allowed finite numbers for labels and input bounds; no new bound policy
Validation issues: severity/code/message strings; person_id/unit_id/posting_id nullable text; severity not enumerated so forward labels survive
Leave summary: valid actual ISO starts_on/ends_on loop bounds within the selected monthly calendar, ordered to prevent malformed or unbounded date loops; total_requests/people_on_leave/total_leave_days finite numbers; call_level_counts/unit_counts numeric maps; busiest_day nullable date/count object
Leave calendar: days object with array values; each entry needs person_name/status/leave_type/leave_slot strings used by split/localeCompare/status labels; unit/posting_type/call_level nullable text
Leave requests: array; each row needs id/status/leave_type/leave_slot/starts_on/ends_on strings; person.id/canonical_name and nullable person.call_level; days finite number; dates may span adjacent months and status/type labels are unrestricted
Leave pressure: unit_totals/call_level_totals numeric maps; days array with date string and total_people/blocking_people finite numbers; unused blockers/day.entries/day.unit_counts/start/end are not required

boundary_notes: Read shape validation does not normalize responses, mutate payloads, establish scheduling eligibility, constrain server enums, or add API/backend contracts.
All three Leave responses validate before any one is committed. Malformed JSON-200 takes the existing saved-but-stale error route with manual GET retry; no mutation replay.

Monthly calendar loop bounds are constrained to the requested month because this endpoint paints one month and existing loops otherwise accept unbounded or invalid response dates. Cross-month leave requests/posting periods remain accepted.

Optional absent monthly Unit counts remain accepted. Existing board aggregate leave_days reduction may still produce NaN when such counts are absent; that is a separate existing renderer issue, not grounds to reject a snapshot which intentionally supports unavailable per-unit counts.

This is not a full server schema validator and does not prove renderer exception atomicity after validated data is committed. Actual malformed-response browser checks and an independent review remain required before integration acceptance.
